title: Evidence Collection Checklist
description: CAT 531 textbook section connecting evidence collection checklist to Design Tension Studio map naming a classroom value conflict and negotiated decision, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze how the Design Tension Studio map naming a classroom value conflict and negotiated decision shows a defensible decision in CAT 531.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to make a classroom technology decision more defensible.
